title: Credential-named key whose value is on the next line: must be flagged
summary: The same key with its value on the same line (also after a horizontal tab), which is a genuine assignment. Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: Matching across a line break turns prompts and structure into false credentials. The value must be on the same logical line or in the same block.

expectation.rationale: Issue-specific literal/password range; expectations are the project’s masking policy.
